$description: The menu a brand chooses from. A brand (brands/<brand>/brand.json) names one option per axis; the build turns the choices into that brand's primitives. Change a value here and every brand using it changes.

radius.$description: radius.base per preset. Every radius step is a multiple of the base (core.json).

spacing.$description: Multiplier on the default ladder; every step is then rounded to the 2px grid (space.px and space.0 never scale).

space.$description: The default spacing ladder (Tailwind's). A brand's ladder is this × its spacing multiplier, rounded to 2px.

fonts.$description: Known families: the CSS fallback stack, and Figma's style name for each weight (it differs by font — Inter says "Semi Bold", JetBrains Mono says "SemiBold").

Inter.stack: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

JetBrains Mono.stack: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
